description: This file contains automated API test cases for employee and admin workflows, specifically testing CRUD operations on job titles via REST API endpoints using RestAssured and JUnit 5.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkflowApiTest
classes.description: A test class extending BaseApiTest to verify employee and admin API workflows, including creating and listing job titles, and unauthorized access checks.

methods.name: adminCanCreateJobTitle_thenItAppearsInList
methods.description: Test verifying that an admin can create a new job title via API and that it appears in the list of job titles.

methods.name: unauthenticatedRequest_isForbiddenOrUnauthorized
methods.description: Test verifying that unauthenticated requests to the job titles API endpoint are properly rejected with 401 or 403 status.
